description: The line plot illustrates the ASR (Attack Success Rate) across different domains—cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, Estadio, and athletics—for three distinct methods: start (teal), random (orange), and end (purple), as part of the "Efficient Trigger Word Insertion" study. The x-axis represents the domain, with labels spaced evenly across the horizontal axis, while the y-axis, labeled "ASR," ranges from 0.5 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, indicating the success rate of the attack. The "start" method (teal line with circular markers) begins at an ASR of approximately 0.77 for "cf," dips to 0.49 at "bb," then rises sharply to 0.90 at "WNBA," fluctuates with a peak of 0.92 at "Estadio," and ends at 0.93 for "athletics." The "random" method (orange line with 'x' markers) starts at 0.66 for "cf," drops to 0.51 at "bb," rises to 0.89 at "Estadio," and ends at 0.87 for "athletics." The "end" method (purple line with circular markers) begins at 0.76 for "cf," drops to 0.57 at "bb," rises to 0.89 at "WNBA," peaks at 0.96 at "Estadio," and ends at 0.83 for "athletics." The legend in the bottom-right corner identifies the three methods by their respective colors and markers.
